Ecuador player Hincapie red-carded for covering mouth at World Cup

Ecuadorian footballer Piero Hincapie was shown a red card during a World Cup match against Mexico. The disciplinary action was taken because he covered his mouth before the game, an act interpreted as a violation of rules. This incident marks him as the second player to be sent off for a similar infraction in the tournament.
